This needs a top-of-deck look/select effect that sends unchosen viewed cards to cemetery; implement engine support for search/look effects with remainderTo cemetery or a dedicated peek-and-choose-to-EX-area effect.

The current encoding targets the enemy leader directly as a separate choice and loses the linkage to the selected follower's leader; implement support for 'that follower's leader' targeting and cemetery named-card minimum conditions.

The text 'You can put up to 6 of this card into your deck' is missing from the encoding; if deck construction rules are represented in this DSL, add support for non-gameplay deck limit metadata, otherwise this is engine-missing metadata support.

Passive restriction is overbroad: the source says 'If this follower has no Fable counters, it can't attack enemies,' not 'can't attack' at all. Encode a conditional can't-attack-enemies-only restriction based on this follower having 0 Fable counters. Implement engine support for conditions checking counters on source and for 'can't attack enemies' distinct from full cannotAttack.

Activated cost is missing 'bury a Forest Bat'; encode the [act] cost as engage this card and bury a Forest Bat from your field. Implement activated cost support for burying a matching follower by identity/name or token name.
